questions.question: Will the NFL give written consent for systematic retrieval of the injury report and club depth pages?
questions.known: Terms §1.3 prohibit systematic retrieval absent express prior written consent (evidence file). The terms name a Legal Department address for written permission requests, in the linking provisions; the terms do not say whether that route covers data retrieval.
questions.missing: Any answer from the NFL. No consent has been requested or granted.
questions.discover: Send a written request to the address in the terms, describing the capture and its cadence. Record the reply in the repository with its date. No capture starts before a written answer exists.

questions.question: Does analysis of published NFL facts, for originated betting lines, fall within NFL.com terms §12?
questions.known: §12 prohibits using the Services to gamble or wager on the result of any NFL game (verbatim in evidence). This desk makes no legal determination.
questions.missing: A legal opinion on the project's use of the Services and of its published facts.
questions.discover: Take advice from qualified counsel on the verbatim text and on the project's uses. Record the answer with its date before any line is published.

questions.question: Is there an official NFL snap-count source covering all 32 clubs?
questions.known: The 2026-11-18 search returned third-party snap-count sites only (evidence file). No official source was located.
questions.missing: An official source, its licence terms, and its club coverage.
questions.discover: Check the league's official statistics pages for a published snap-count table, and ask the league whether snap data is available under a licence. Verify coverage for all 32 clubs before any join.

questions.question: Which Week 10 injury count matches the official report as published?
questions.known: Committed captures give 326 rows (availability desk, 2026-11-13), 276 rows (assurance desk) and 347 rendered rows (2026-11-17). The brief's 254/279 targets are not reproduced.
questions.missing: A complete official recount taken at a recorded clock time, row by row, with a hash of the raw text.
questions.discover: Re-read the official injury report page once, in full (all chunks), record the clock time and the SHA-256 of each chunk, and reconcile row by row against the three captures.

questions.question: Which Week 1-10 results file is canonical?
questions.known: The 149-row and 150-row files differ only by the LAC@BAL final.
questions.missing: A decision on which file the backtest corpus reads.
questions.discover: Owner choice. The LAC@BAL final is confirmed by the fresh-reads desk from the official game centre.

questions.question: Which requirement register does the landing page render?
questions.known: Four registers exist with different row counts and statuses (flag F-REG).

questions.question: Which past seasons of official results and injury reports can be used for a train/validation/holdout split?
questions.known: The repository holds one season of results (2026, Weeks 1-10 final). No past-season injury archive has been located.
questions.missing: Official results and reports for at least three seasons, and the terms position for retrieving them.
questions.discover: Locate the league's season results pages for earlier seasons and record their terms position under §1.3 before retrieval.

questions.question: Does an authorised structured source exist for the Houston depth chart?
questions.known: The Houston depth page was read on 2026-11-13 and no depth table appeared in the rendered text (X28-HOU-DEPTH). Nothing was substituted. Whether the chart is an image was not established by that read.
questions.discover: Ask the club or the league for a structured version. Until one exists, Houston stays out of the depth model.

questions.question: Which pre-2026 assumptions should the priors filter correct, and by how much?
questions.known: The filter's right-hand column is empty on every row by design.
questions.discover: Owner or modeller completes each row with a source and a sized effect, or records that none is needed.

questions.question: Is there a rights-cleared price source for the originated-line comparison?
questions.known: nfl.com/odds renders a 404 (2026-11-18). No official price was located. Third-party price data is rights-restricted per the register.
questions.missing: A price source with written permission to use it.
questions.discover: Ask the operator or data licensor for written terms. No price is used until those terms are recorded.
